text:
lina: FYI pulled results from the sable-7b-int4 bring-up on GTN slices. Link: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/sable7b/2026-03-22/run-summary.json High level: ~52% token compute savings vs int6, median latency down from 140ms -> 98ms, p95 520ms -> 360ms. Quality: overall EM 0.915 -> 0.897 (drop 1.8 pts). However long-context (>3000 tokens) EM shows a 5.5 pt regression and a spike in hallucination_count on extraction tasks.

noah: thanks. can you share per-intent deltas? search vs summarization vs code?

lina: quick split in the snapshot: search EM delta +0.2 (ok), summarization -3.8, code-generation -0.9. The long-context regression is concentrated on multi-document summarization and timeline-extraction intents.

priya: sounds like quant noise accumulates across extended KV chains. two immediate ops thoughts: 1) don't route multi-doc summarization to int4; 2) try a lightweight mixed-precision profile: keep middle N layers at int4 but preserve first 2 and last 2 at int6. that recovered ~70% of the long-context EM in a previous run.

tyler: another option is token-saliency fallback: compute a cheap importance score on the prefix and route to int6 if the prefix contains >X named entities or >Y tokens flagged as citations. low-lift and keeps most traffic on int4. example rule we can use:
```json
{
  "routing_rule": "saliency_fallback",
  "entity_threshold": 8,
  "citation_tokens_threshold": 120,
  "fallback_model": "sable-7b-int6",
  "canary": 3
}
```

lina: interesting — product would like minimal complexity. can we do a 48h canary at 3% with shadowing to int6 and enable an alert when EM delta >1pt for any critical slice?

noah: 3% is small but fine for initial validation. prefer 48h to capture diurnal load. also add a priming-entropy probe: measure avg token-entropy drift between int4 and int6 on long-context samples. that often indicates where outputs degrade.

priya: on quant experiments, i'll run two parallel builds: (A) per-layer outlier-clipping + 8-bit compensation on top of int4, (B) mixed-precision with first/last layers int6. estimate: A adds +6-8% cost, B adds +10-12%. run both shadowed for the canary.

tyler: ops: can deploy-bot start the canary and wire the gtn_em, hallucination_rate, latency_p95, and token_entropy metrics into the alerting dashboard? set EM delta alert threshold to 1.0 pt on critical slices (multi-doc-summary, timelines). also create a rollback rule if hallucination_rate > 0.5% absolute increase.

deploy-bot: Canary started: sable-7b-int4 at 3% traffic. Shadowing enabled to sable-7b-int6 for full-sample comparison. Additional shadows: experiment-A (outlier-clip) and experiment-B (mixed-precision) attached. Monitors: gtn_em, hallucination_rate, latency_p95, token_entropy. Alerts configured: em_delta_critical >= 1.0, hallucination_delta >= 0.5%.

lina: adding two failing prompt excerpts to the ticket for GTN review — pasted below (redacted):
1) "Synthesize action items from these five meeting notes across three documents and produce a chronological timeline." (~3.2k tokens) -> int4 invented dates when sources ambiguous.
2) "Extract all cited references and map to source paragraphs" (~3.8k tokens) -> int4 duplicated citations and merged unrelated paragraphs.

noah: thanks. i'll open infra/eng-ml#1307 with snapshots, failing prompts, and an evaluation checklist (slices: 512/1024/2k/3k+, intents: search/summarize/code). assign to @priya + @lina.

priya: experiment plan: queue 10k long-context priming samples through A/B shadowing overnight, collect token_entropy diff, EM per-slice, and hallucination_count. will post results in ticket.

tyler: operationally we'll keep hybrid routing off for now. if the canary shows >1pt EM regression on any critical slice, we'll flip the saliency_fallback rule with a 1% immediate reroute for matching sessions. rollback playbook is prepped in the ticket.

lina: timeline approved by product. we'll run 48h canary then evaluate. if mixed-precision B recovers >80% of the EM gap with cost delta <12%, recommend promoting B to 30% and re-evaluating after 72h.

tyler: quick note: schedule a follow-up sync after 48h with product/GTN on the ticket. keep slack updates short.

(emoji reactions: :rocket: on deploy-bot message, :eyes: on priya comment)
